value.rationale: Among naturally paired balanced words of the same length, aperiodic/unbordered and highly periodic/alternating forbidden patterns have exactly identical mean letter densities, while their entropy and digit-count susceptibility are strictly oppositely ordered for every k. This supplies a motivated all-parameter fluctuation classification and sharp 4^{-k} scale, not a single numerical exercise or a known-table recomputation.
